gen-gf-paprika-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Loud, loose and spread out, Paprika fills every line with lowercase that stands tall as capitals would. And Kdam Thmor Pro, with bowls that fill their space, can stay at a modest size without losing its footing.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-matemasie: Big, loose, spread-out Paprika announces itself. Paprika does its best work shouting from a distance, while sans-serif Matemasie, with closed letters and broad gaps, does its best work up close.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-momo-trust-display: Paprika's counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open, and its lowercase stands as tall as capitals. Momo Trust Display, sans-serif and generous in x-height, gives it quiet company.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mukta: Expressive to the core, Paprika scatters its letters and gives the lowercase real presence. Yet what stands out most is how Mukta, sans-serif with tall-bodied small letters, steadies all that showmanship.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mukta-malar: Paprika's letters drift apart, each lowercase form standing as tall as a capital. And Paprika shouts best from far off, while Mukta Malar, a sans with compressed ascenders, works best up close.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-play: Paprika scatters its letters at a distance, each lowercase form as imposing as a capital. Play, with its little height difference between cases and sturdy bowls, grounds that boldness on the page.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-smooch-sans: Paprika's counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open, and its letters scatter. Smooch Sans tucks in close beneath it, with a high midline and an s that opens generously between its bends.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Paprika is all loose, loud swagger on the page. Sofia Sans Condensed stays easy on the eye paragraph after paragraph, its big x-height and pen-lifted curves leaving no hairlines to fuss over.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-spline-sans-mono: Big, brash and scattered, Paprika towers over Spline Sans Mono, whose flat, fixed-width letters read like code. Paprika does its finest work when it is big and brief, never crowded.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-truculenta: Truculenta crowds its letters into a compact line, with short ascenders and rounded forms that stay open to the side. And where Paprika does its best work shouting, Truculenta does its best work murmuring.
